scope: Implement/test the reviewed recovery-only winning response through existing shared password/passkey/TOTP execution, BFF/owner wrappers and typed frontend completion, including the exact3-fileC#patch and bounded follow-on paths in the packet.
prior_automatic_rejection: This patch changes the shared step-up authentication execution/result lifecycle and recovery-secret disposal across passkey/TOTP paths, creating a broad security and service-disruption blast radius; the available trusted user authorization does not specifically cover this high-impact shared-boundary change.
regressions: Existing password/passkey/TOTP proof/session/current-policy/expiry/composite causal revoke regressions unchanged.
Recovery winner exists only after confirmed commit and successful transaction disposal; save/commit/UNKNOWN/dispose failure clears pending carrier.
Owner rejection/final recovery policy or row drift rolls back mutation/proof/outbox and disposes carrier.
ForPasskey/ForTotp preserve unrelated witness/carrier fields; incompatible closed shape is rejected, never silently dropped or treated as causal exception.
Legacy boolean entry rejects recovery scope before mutation delegate is invoked.
Duplicate/completed/native continuation reads return safe metadata only; an ACTIVE original proof may win after owner rollback.
Dedicated BFF follow-on: completion-hook failure, cancellation before write, midwrite abort and safe body-loss reconciliation never redisclose.
All new tests/assertions/logs/TRX report fixed facts only, never codes/verifiers/buffers/context values.
exclusions: No new production policy/capacity/session or replacement selection
No generic secret transport, second proof engine or read-again escrow
No protected-main merge, production publication/activation or release
acceptance: Not final implementation/security/work-item acceptance; all required tests and gates remain.
